title: Pond BOD removal for plug flow
applicability: Pond efficiency for plug flow when BOD exertion is described by a first order reaction; the value of Kl varies between 0.05 and 0.2 per day and is independent of temperatures above 15ºC.
notes: The subscript of K is printed as an italic lower-case l (Kl), not the digit 1.
